title: Evidence
description: A single evidence record backing a claim. Every material claim in an output must trace to at least one Evidence object.

source.description: Publishing body, e.g. 'U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics'

title.description: Report/dataset title, e.g. 'Occupational Outlook Handbook: Electricians'

published_at.description: ISO date or year of publication

retrieved_at.description: ISO date the agent accessed it

methodology_note.description: One line: survey/model/administrative data, sample basis

level.description: S=official/primary, A=major research, B=industry, C=secondary media, D=unverified (never usable)
